title: TypeScript Essentials
description: Add rock-solid static types to JavaScript. Master type annotations, interfaces, union narrowing, generics, utility types, and strict TypeScript 5 patterns.
outcomes: Annotate variables, functions, and objects with strict TypeScript types
Model complex domain shapes using interfaces, type aliases, and literal unions
Narrow union types safely with typeof, in, and discriminated unions
Build reusable type-safe helpers with generics (<T>)
Transform existing types concisely using Partial, Pick, Omit, and Record
